_doc: Match mutators (the Daily Challenge draws two; Chaos Cup stacks them). Each is a set of keys MatchSim.apply_mutators reads: air_mult scales every launch's air time, speed_mult every fighter's walking speed, damage_mult every hit's damage (both ways), surge_every fills every Surge meter every N ticks, pit_floor sinks that share of the floor into chasms at the start (clear of the spawns, in a seeded pattern). hazards lists arena hazards from data/rules/hazards.json (a tidal wave, a meteor shower, a rolling boulder, a fault line); two mutators' hazards add up.
